class.name: FoxSprintManager
class.brief_description: Component that manages the intents and threshold math for sprinting.
class.description: Tracks the player's sprint requests and provides the speed variables needed by the state machine, decoupling locomotion tuning from the root character.

method.name: request
method.description: Registers an intent from the controller to sprint.

method.name: has_request
method.description: Returns true if a sprint is currently being requested.

method.name: is_below_dropoff
method.description: Evaluates a given velocity against the dropoff threshold. Used by the state machine to force-cancel a sprint if the character hits a wall.

members.member: The target speed when sprinting, in meters per second.
The percentage of sprint_speed the character's velocity must drop below to automatically break out of a sprint. (Default 0.05 = 5%).

signal.name: requested
signal.description: Emitted when a sprint is requested.

signal.name: cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when a sprint request is cancelled.
